title: UK military jamming other nations' satellites to defend itself, BBC told
description: The head of the RAF says the UK faces "unprecedented threats" from adversaries in space, as a new unit is created to defend Britain's satellites.

title: Home secretary says undetected migrant landings 'unacceptable'
description: The arrivals of two unescorted migrant boats mark the first uncontrolled landings recorded in the UK since 2025.

title: Watch: Moment pilots eject as RAF jet crashes in Anglesey
description: The two pilots ejected from the jet before crash and sustained minor injuries.

title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

title: Police examine video of anti-migrant activist slashing dinghy with knife
description: Daniel Thomas, known to his supporters as Danny Tommo, livestreamed a video of the alleged incident.

title: Family tribute to 'devoted' mum and 'precious' children who died in fire
description: Elisha Brabin, 36, and her children, Leo, 16, Ellis, 8, and Prudence, 7, died in Bootle on Tuesday.

title: UK to review Chagos Islands deal over lack of US support, Streeting tells BBC
description: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting has confirmed the review after Donald Trump told Andy Burnham the deal was "terrible".

title: Watch: Trump and Xi are meeting on US soil - what's on their agenda?
description: The BBC’s China correspondent and US editor explain everything you need to know ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting in Washington DC.

title: Singer Michael Kiwanuka reveals he is recovering from a stroke
description: The award-winning musician says he faces a "tough journey ahead" after a "quite severe" brain injury.
